auth.credential_policy: no Authorization header, bearer token, or token value copied

integrity.raw_response_policy: *.response is the untouched gh --include envelope; *.http and *.body are exact header/body segments; *.stderr is preserved

limits.detail: The supplemental list/direct GETs were captured 2026-09-20 08:53-08:54 UTC; the approved Homebrew check-runs body was captured 05:20 UTC. List-only queued suites are authentic current responses but are not retroactively asserted as original check-run positives.
Queued Claude and DCO suites appear in the complete four-page list but not in the approved 05:20 check-runs page; direct raw suite and Claude App envelopes are included for explicit mapping.
No artifact endpoint was queried here; no workflow_run.run_attempt value is inferred.
Velnor list total_count=3 across pages 1-3; Homebrew list total_count=4 across pages 1-4; raw Link headers are retained and last pages have no next relation.
This is provider fixture evidence for checker/mapper regression, not live gate truth or rollout authority.

fields.has_next: exact rel token next parsed from Link field
fields.link_header: case-insensitive Link field; leading field OWS removed; value spaces/tabs preserved
fields.response_date_header: case-insensitive Date field; leading field OWS removed; value spaces/tabs preserved

metadata_derivation.line_endings: LF and CRLF accepted; only line-ending CR is removed
metadata_derivation.parser: line-oriented HTTP header parser over each referenced raw/*.http file

assertions: missing Date and Link fields produce absent independently
Date values retain embedded spaces and leading-tab OWS is handled without column shifting
Link values retain embedded tabs and rel=next remains an exact token
records are emitted as structured JSON objects, never TSV columns
